label: HMM (states + transitions)
methodsText: Per-cell behaviour was modelled with a {numStates}-state hidden Markov model on {modelMeasurements} of {pops} cells, fitted across all images, and state transitions were counted per track.
purpose: Run HMM states, then HMM transitions
useWhen: The usual way to give each cell a behaviour state per timepoint
Before Cluster tracks, which can read states and transitions

notWhen.text: Tracks have no speed or angle: run Track measures first

notWhen: States look wrong: check segmentation and tracking before the states
